masthead.label: SUCCESSION — JAPAN
masthead.lede: A business built over decades carries weight — in its name, its people, its relationships. Our work is to receive it, and to continue it.

readInJapanese.prefix: このページは日本語でもご覧いただけます —

commonality.h2: Having no successor is common — and it is not a failure.
commonality.body: A large share of small companies in Japan face the same question. It is a structural fact of this era, not a judgment on the business. The question is simply how good work continues — and we offer one answer.

offer.body: We are operators, not a fund. We do not buy to sell.

criteria.body: Design, print, web production, IT services, hosting and maintenance — work adjacent to what the group already does.
Kanagawa and the Kanto region preferred; elsewhere in Japan welcome to inquire.

steps.text: A confidential first meeting — no obligation, no documents required.
Understanding the business, at your pace — weeks or months, as it takes.
Terms discussed together with your existing advisors — we work alongside them, never around them.
Succession — and after it, the name, the people, and the work continue.

process.closing: We will never hurry you. There is no timetable but yours.

advisors.body: We equally welcome contact from tax advisors, financial institutions, and succession-support organisations on behalf of owners.
